definitions.short: a fly (especially one of a stinging nature)
definitions.full: H2070. zebub זְבוּב noun masculine Eccl 10:1 fly (as moving to and fro in the air? compare Fl NHWB i. 438 b ; Late Hebrew id. , Assyrian zumbu , Dl S 63 f. ; Arabic , Aramaic דִּיבָבָא , , ); — literal only מָוֶת זְבוּבֵי 10:1 i.e. dead flies ; so AV RV Hi Now and others; > ᵐ5 De and others death-bringing, deadly flies ; זְבוּב metaphor of Egyptian army Isa 7:18 (|| דְּבוֺרָה , bee , of Assyrian); on זְבוּב בַּעַל see בַּעַל II. 4 , p. 127 above
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to flit );

occurrences.englishText: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor;
It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
